name: Queen Agnes
biography: Queen Agnes was one of the three 'Queens' who led the 1878 Fireburn on St. Croix. Together with Queen Mary and Queen Mathilda, she organized laborers across the island to rise up against the exploitative contract labor system that had replaced formal slavery. Agnes played a key role in coordinating the destruction of plantation estates during the three-day uprising. She was arrested, tried, and sentenced to hard labor. Her courage in the face of a system designed to perpetuate servitude under a different name is remembered as an act of profound moral clarity.
notes: One of the three 'Queens' of the 1878 Fireburn on St. Croix. Organized laborers against the exploitative contract labor system.
